run_flask_laser_server: run the flask LASER encoder server on port 80 with debug mode enabled
vectorize_text_to_embedding: send a GET request to /vectorize with query params q and lang to get text embeddings
encode_multilingual_sentences: use the LaserEncoderPipeline to encode sentences into multilingual embeddings for a given language
cache_laser3_encoders: cache LASER3 encoders by language code to avoid reloading models for repeated requests
check_laser2_language_support: check if a language is supported by LASER2 using the LASER2_LANGUAGE list before encoding
